label: A represented complete history recovers the switch schedule but leaves root attributes open
paraphrase: For admitted #468 routes paired with #1867 Boolean copy/toggle schedules, the complete generated trace identifies the switch schedule. Two admitted routes with the same trace have opposite HAS_INTELLECT_1 and HAS_WILL_1 values at the designated root, so neither attribute is identified. The nonempty restriction by the existing immateriality-to-intellect and intellect-to-will premises makes both attributes true throughout. An augmented map identifies the attribute pair exactly when some permitted report separates each same-history pair with different attributes. This is a control on the supplied profile, with source-to-history applicability and any real separating report OPEN.
